text:
MAP-FORMAT FIX — the game-file is bloated and B64-wrapped. Diagnosis (measured): the baked game-file is 2.22MB B64 = 1.67MB raw, and the ENTIRE 1.67MB is ONE lump — the MAP — stored enc=raw (uncompressed). Everything else (skins/logic/manifest) is 8 bytes. The map is a DENSE 360x360 tile grid written in full even though the world is near-empty. That is the Guiding-Light violation: storing the product, not the factors. Build to docs/game/GUIDING_LIGHT.md (the fork table: "store the dense form → store the references"; "JSON/base64 at runtime → pack binary, zero-copy").

TWO FIXES, in priority order:

1. RLE THE MAP LUMP — the 100x win. The format ALREADY has rle8/rle16 encodings (see the lump directory + RLE_FORMAT.md); the bake just writes the map as `raw`. Encode the MAP lump with the existing RLE codec so a near-empty 360x360 grid collapses from 1.67MB to a few KB. The loader's map decode must read the RLE'd lump (the Zig codec already supports rle8/rle16 — wire the map path through it). Do NOT change what the map MEANS — same world, just compressed. Round-trip identical.

2. DROP B64 -> RAW PACKED BINARY for the ship/loader artifact. The .b64 text wrapper forces a decode pass and adds 33%. The loader should read raw bytes zero-copy (it already decodes lumps from bytes — the B64 is just a transport wrapper). Keep whatever's needed for the dev/bake path, but the artifact the loader loads should be packed binary, used in place.

VERIFY (report numbers): bake the same world, report the game-file size BEFORE vs AFTER (expect MB -> KB). `tools/rjit game play` must render the IDENTICAL world (RLE + binary round-trip exactly — same pieces, floor, player, sky). Zero V8 in the loader. If size doesn't drop dramatically, the RLE isn't actually engaging — don't report done.

BAR: ONLY the user running `tools/rjit game play` and seeing the same world render (now from a tiny file) counts. Report the before/after byte sizes + what to run. NEVER self-declare GREEN.

GUARDS: no stubs — real RLE encoding that actually shrinks the file, not a rename. Zero V8 in the loader. Own context — NO Task tool, NO subagents. tools/rjit only. Commit EXPLICIT paths (NOT git add -A; ~400 set-aside files). No reset/revert.
resolution: Implemented the map-format fix in commit 7500609fc. The runtime artifact is now raw packed binary at zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile instead of hmsc.gamefile.b64, and the CLI installs content-addressed player assets into zig-out/game/contentstore before launching the no-V8 loader. The map stream now references the full player model/animation by asset key instead of embedding them as map lumps; the figure geometry was restored to the original full V2/Characters3D bake, not reduced. Measured baseline was 2,271,324 bytes b64 / 1,703,492 bytes decoded raw; current bake is 39,852 bytes raw game-file / 53,136 bytes b64 transport, with 1,665,796 bytes installed as two verified content-addressed assets. Nested STREAM_MAP is 39,616 bytes; TILES remains rle16 at 3,372 bytes and HEIGHTS rle16 at 1,452 bytes. Local checks run: tools/rjit game shot, tools/rjit game verify, zig build test-world-gamefile, zig build test-world-mapfile. User should run tools/rjit game play and confirm the same world renders with the restored detailed player figure; not marked done, awaiting your verification.
